scope: Two new presentation-only files; no frozen science edits

issues.issue: summary.get('evidence_sha256', {}) plus conditional lookup silently skips missing, undeclared or unsafe historical evidence references
issues.impact: Helper can report PASS without required historical-to-public byte-domain links; confirmed missing-required-proof.json and ../../outside.json both pass when placed in summary.evidence_sha256.
issues.fix: Require a nonempty evidence mapping, mandatory coverage of freeze plus all 46 enriched and 46 raw records, validate every reference path/digest and require every reference in public inventory with matching original_sha256. Publish additional cache structured JSON rather than adding implicit exceptions. Add negative tests for missing/empty key, traversal, missing reference, omitted mandatory entry and historical-hash mismatch.

issues.issue: Record identity is not explicitly bound to its controller/geometry/reset filename tuple
issues.impact: Swapping complete same-controller map file pairs leaves a full valid record-key matrix for the auditor but mislabels the public artifact links.
issues.fix: Before aggregation require (bundle.controller, bundle.geometry_seed, bundle.reset_seed)==(controller,geometry,reset) for each expected filename; test swapped-map files with corresponding public checksums updated.

independent_real_frozen_auditor_syntheti.note: Plumbing evidence only: synthetic arrays, real frozen auditor/science20/base6 bytes and existing checkpoint bytes; not current training/holdout evidence.

nonblocking_trust_boundary: The verifier imports auditor Python from --root. Use a trusted reviewed checkout/commit. A self-supplied manifest is an integrity inventory, not an authenticity/signature trust anchor.
root_coordination: Root accepted mandatory public mapping of all summary structured JSON references, preserving all original scientific SHA values; fix not yet present in reviewed bytes.
remaining_validation: Re-review owner fixes and rerun stdlib tests before publication-helper approval. Actual nine-run main and actual 8050 holdout remain unverified by this review.
